events.text: oh no, I think my order is going to my old address. I just moved last week and only now noticed the delivery is headed to 81 Ridge Rd. Is there any way to fix that?
I can help with that. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me your full name and either the email address or the phone number on your account.
Sure, my full name is Hannah Schultz. The email on my account is hschultz@post.example.

Thank you, Hannah, you're verified. I looked at your order O-5107 from Saffron Lane, and I'm sorry to say I can't change its address. The driver has already picked it up (status "picked up"), and our policy only allows address changes while an order is still being prepared. The same rule means I can't cancel it either.

Here's what you can do:
- Contact the driver through the app, if it offers that, and ask them to bring it to your new address.
- Watch for the delivery at 81 Ridge Rd. If you can reach someone there, they could hold the food for you.

If the order ends up not arriving, or something is missing or wrong, contact us again and we'll look at what the policy allows. Is there anything else I can help with?

Okay, thank you for checking. I did give you my order number, it's 5107, so I'm not sure if that's the same as O-5107 on your end, but it sounds like the one. Before I accept that, could you tell me whether there's any way to cancel and get a refund? I'd really rather not pay for dinner that ends up at my old place.

You're right to check. To be clear, I found that order from your account, not from the number you gave. It's the only recent order on your account, and it's the one going to 81 Ridge Rd. So yes, 5107 and O-5107 are the same order.

I can't cancel it or refund it. Cancellations are only possible while an order is still being prepared. This one was picked up at 7:24 PM, so it's on its way. Picked-up orders can't be cancelled, and the policy doesn't allow a refund just because the food is going to the wrong address.

Here's what I can still do:
- If the order arrives late (more than 15 minutes after the 7:40 PM promised time), you'd get account credit. You can contact us again after delivery.
- If something is missing or wrong when it arrives, report it within 48 hours of delivery and we'll compensate the affected items.
- If you'd like a person to review your situation, I can pass your case to a human specialist. They'd follow up within 24 hours, though I can't promise a particular outcome.

Would you like me to do that?

I see, so the address can't be changed and the order can't be cancelled or refunded. That's disappointing, but I understand the rules are the rules.

I don't really want a specialist review, since I just need to know what to do so the food doesn't go to my old place. I'll try reaching the driver through the app and maybe ask someone at Ridge Rd if they can hold it.

Thanks for checking, Hannah's out of luck tonight, I guess. I'll accept it.

I'm sorry I couldn't do more tonight, Hannah. Your plan is the best option: message the driver in the app right away, and ask someone at Ridge Rd to hold the food if it gets there first. The sooner the driver knows, the better the chance they can reroute.

If anything goes wrong with the delivery, like a late arrival or a missing or wrong item, contact us again and we'll see what we can do. I hope you get your dinner, and good luck with the new place!
